label: Agent Overrides
title: Project — Agent Overrides
subtitle: Customise individual agent behaviour for this project without affecting global settings.
description: The Agents tab in project settings lets you override any agent field for this project alone. Fields you change here take precedence over the global definition; a Reset button restores them to the global value.

settings.name: Agent Instructions
settings.description: Replaces the global system prompt for this agent in this project only. Useful for giving an agent a more specific role or tone within a particular engagement.

settings.name: Model Override
settings.description: Use a different model for this agent in this project, independently of the project-level model override.

settings.name: Tool Assignments
settings.description: Which tools this agent can invoke in this project (may be a subset or superset of the global list).

settings.name: Workflow Assignments
settings.description: Which workflows this agent has access to in this project.

settings.name: Knowledge Database Assignments
settings.description: Additional shared or custom databases this agent can use in the project. The project's primary database is always available.

settings.name: Reset to Defaults
settings.description: Restores all overridden fields to their global values for this agent in one click.

mediaCaption: Per-project agent settings showing overridden fields highlighted alongside unchanged fields that still show the global value
tips: You can have the same agent behave as a strict editor in one project and a creative brainstorming partner in another by setting different system prompts per project.
If an override is causing unexpected behaviour, the Reset button is the quickest way to rule out the override as the cause.
